stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: Readiness probe failures during deploys
stub_knowledge.chunk: Transient readiness probe failures during a rolling update are expected while old pods drain and new pods warm up. Correlate the failure window with ScalingReplicaSet events and deployment rollout history; if new pods are Running and Ready with clean logs, the incident is benign and deploy-related. Escalate only if probe failures persist after the rollout completes.

stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: Distinguishing benign deploys from regressions
stub_knowledge.chunk: A deploy-related blip shows: Normal ScalingReplicaSet events, new ReplicaSet pods healthy, no error logs on new pods, and no correlated alerts on dependencies. A regression shows persistent 5xx, crash loops, or dependency alerts after the rollout. When in doubt, a human should compare error rates before and after the deploy.

useful_rubric_notes: Useful when the draft recognizes the rollout correlation and concludes likely-benign rather than inventing a fault, with citations.
